name: bash-npx-tsc-blocked-wrong-reason
description: Reproduces a PreToolUse block on `npx tsc --noEmit` that fired for the WRONG reason. In the live session the hook denied with a sentiment/trust message ('User appears frustrated (trust: normal). Blocking Bash unless explicitly requested.') after the user said 'please delete correctly' — the sentiment rule treated a neutral correction request as a frustration signal. The CORRECT deny reason is the build/typecheck blacklist: `npx tsc` is covered by command-patterns.ts at `/\b(tsc|npx\s+tsc)\b/` with alternative 'You must run mcp__agent-framework__check'. Goal: codify that the block must come from the blacklist (tool-approve fastDeny), not from sentiment, so the user is directed to `mcp__agent-framework__check` instead of a generic frustration gate.
